    ABOUT

    A fan-made, offline Pokédex covering all 151 Pokémon of Generation I, styled after the in-game Pokédex of Pokémon Red/Blue. It ships as one HTML file: data, sprites, cries, fonts — everything is embedded and works without internet.

    ↑ ↓ browse   / search   C cry   P palette   R random   Esc close

    Mark Pokémon as Seen (automatic while browsing) and Owned (pokeball button) to fill your dex status, just like the game. The entry text flips pages like the original, and the palette button switches between Game Boy and Pocket screen colors.
